facts.text: Caroline painted a piece after visiting an LGBTQ center, aiming to capture unity and strength.

evidence.quote: I painted this after I visited a LGBTQ center. I wanted to capture everyone's unity and strength.

facts.text: Melanie expressed admiration for Caroline's painting, noting its vivid colors and unified appearance.

evidence.quote: Wow, Caroline, that painting is awesome! Those colors are so vivid and the whole thing looks really unified.

facts.text: Melanie and her children completed another painting similar to their previous one.

evidence.quote: My kids and I just finished another painting like our last one.
